summary: Created the feedback request batch-upload test-design artifact with 81 traceable cases covering all planned stories and failure paths: feedback batch/row data model, protected Excel upload UI, parser and row validation, transactional batch creation, unique feedback-link generation, mockable Gmail request emails, delivery status tracking, and non-browser verification. Evidence reviewed included the feedback requirements, current protected placeholder page, Prisma schema without feedback models, package dependencies, dashboard shell protection, and existing server-only Gmail sender pattern. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints.
